conditions.hostLoad: Operator reserved this local-SSD workstation for this run without competing work; supported-platform runs are sequential.
conditions.cacheState: OS cache not flushed; clone checksums and migration preparation precede startup.
conditions.workloadInjection: Two controlled outbox fixtures/second inserted by a benchmark-only preload in the existing SQLite owner. Normal delivery, signing, retry and browser code is unchanged.
conditions.hostReservation: Explicit operator confirmation on 2026-10-12; this flag is an operator attestation, not automatic detection of unrelated processes.
conditions.apiMethod: Four sequential read categories inside the 30-minute measurement, each with concurrency five and 1,000 requests. An independent concurrency-five mutation category is paced across all 30 minutes below the unchanged 60/minute limit. Ten browsers and normal monitoring/webhooks remain active throughout.

mutations.method: Actual CRUD/reservation acknowledgments, paced beneath the unchanged 60/minute operator mutation limit in the full reference profile.

transactions.method: Synchronous Store transaction duration for ordinary finish operations inside the actual SQLite worker; excludes IPC, network and queue delay.

browserInteraction.method: Browser performance.now from the captured input/click event to two animation frames; actual content/network loading is recorded separately as loadedMs.

limitations: Diagnostic durations and sample counts cannot pass the release reference gate.

overload.method: Manual queue pressure uses the actual scheduler domain entry point; HTTP rate-limit pressure is measured separately without bypassing its limit.

storage.backup: NOT TESTED in load run; separate release backup verification remains required.
